einzeiler: A mysterious owl terrorizes and charms freshmen at the University of North Carolina.
kurzfassung: Freshmen at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill found themselves repeatedly chased by a surprisingly aggressive owl outside their dorm. Viral videos and student newspaper columns turned the bird into an online campus sensation. The mystery was finally solved when the wildlife rehabilitator who raised the owl came forward.
stichpunkte: Viral videos showed a barred owl chasing students near Hinton James dorm at UNC Chapel Hill.
Students nicknamed the area Hojo and embraced the bird as an unofficial campus mascot.
A freshman named Alan Chen wrote a student newspaper column defending the owl as a character-building experience.
A TikTok clue eventually led the hosts to Barb, a local woman who raised the owl from a chick.
Barb named the owl Owlison and kept her around the house until she grew too comfortable with humans.
After concerns about student safety, Owlison was safely transferred to a wildlife rescue facility in North Carolina.
The hosts concluded the episode with a lighthearted debate over whether owls actually defecate.

clips.text: The largest freshman dormitory on campus is notoriously considered the worst housing option due to its distant location.

clips.hook: Chased by an owl for 30 minutes
clips.text: A student bursts into her boyfriend's suite in a panic after enduring an unusually long pursuit by a bird.
A witness spots someone feeding the bird a dead mouse and learns the animal was hand-reared by a human.
The wildlife rehabilitator explains how she acquired the baby bird and gave it a clever name.
The hosts resort to an internet search to settle a dispute about avian anatomy and waste elimination.

beschreibung:
This episode was originally published on March 10, 2023.
In 2022, freshmen at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill got a new neighbor: an owl. What wasn't clear was whether the owl was trying to befriend them, or catch them.

Sometimes the owl seemed to be chasing students. Other times, it seemed to come in peace. A popular campus Instagram account reported that a woman had actually raised the owl herself. After she was spotted feeding it, the owl sightings stopped, much to the disappointment of students who'd come to consider it as a sort of mascot. Where had the owl come from, and where did it go?

Endless Thread host Ben Brock Johnson and producer Grace Tatter talk about how the owl gained online campus fame, and get a surprise update from the person who knows the owl best.
